name: Afatinib
drugClass: Second-generation irreversible ErbB-family tyrosine kinase inhibitor
mechanism: Covalent, irreversible pan-ErbB inhibitor blocking signalling from EGFR, HER2 and HER4 homo- and heterodimers. Has activity against several uncommon EGFR mutations (G719X, L861Q, S768I).
interactions: P-glycoprotein inhibitors increase and inducers decrease exposure.
resistance: Acquired T790M mutation is the principal mechanism; bypass signalling and histological transformation also occur.
